title: 第19章  乖有人问说自学成才第20章  滋养幽鳞青蛇
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
“龙……龙阿姨，你这些东西……”
夜离殇感激地看着龙疏寒，但话语还未说完，就被龙疏寒打断了。
“感谢的话，就不用多说了。”
“以我和你母亲梦璃的关系，这些见面礼都是应该的，算不了什么。”
龙疏寒伸手将手枪拿起来，道：“离殇，你要看好，手枪镶嵌妖核的位置在这里，把妖核放进去就可以了，一枚妖核可以发射四十次。”
龙疏寒在讲解的同时，拿起一颗妖核，将其镶嵌在手枪的尾部位置。
“我知道了，龙阿姨。”
夜离殇认真地点点头。
“把东西收起来吧，放入储物背包中，收拾完，我们吃点东西，就要去训练了。”
龙疏寒将储物背包拿起来，放在夜离殇的面前。
“好的，龙阿姨。”
夜离殇答应一声后，就把东西往储物背包里面放。
在将手枪，短剑，妖核，恒温服等物品都放入储物背包后，夜离殇就发现，这储物背包真不一般。
这么多东西放进去，连背包千分之一的空间都没有占到，并且背包的重量也没有任何的变化，就跟一个空包一样。
而且小背包也非常方便携带，出门的时候，往身上一背就行，样式也很好看。
整理完小背包，夜离殇就起身去做饭。
很快，饭菜做好，夜离殇和龙疏寒享用完晚餐，就离开了房间，往城外而去。
……
夜晚。
安静的森林中。

龙疏寒的御兽冰封龙君正在一旁指导云绒狐对于冰属性的运用。
而夜离殇拿着手枪，在龙疏寒的指导下瞄准前方二十米处的一棵古树。
砰砰砰～
夜离殇一连开了十几枪，然后周围逐渐陷入安静。
龙疏寒看着前方的古树，眼神茫然、疑惑。
而夜离殇的脸颊则微微泛红。
“离殇啊，连开十三枪，你是怎么做到的，一枪都没打中的？”
龙疏寒有些不解地询问着。
前方那颗古树，直径大概在半米左右，这么大的一个目标，她是真好奇，夜离殇是怎么做到的，居然一枪都没打中。
“咳～”
“阿姨，那个啥，第一次接触手枪，所以准头可能差了一点。”
夜离殇微微低头，脸红的仿佛能滴出血。
嗯～
content_en:
"Long...Aunt Long, these things like yours..."
Ye Lishang looked at Long Shuhan gratefully, but before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Long Shuhan.
"If you're grateful, there's no need to say more."
"Based on my relationship with your mother Mengli, these meeting gifts are all due and nothing."
Long Shuhan reached out and picked up the pistol and said: "Li Shang, you have to watch carefully. The position where the demon core is embedded in the pistol is here. Just put the demon core in. One demon core can be fired forty times."
While Long Shuhan was explaining, he picked up a demon core and embedded it in the tail of the pistol.
"I understand, Aunt Long."
Ye Li Shang nodded seriously.
"Put your things away and put them in your storage backpack. After packing, we'll have something to eat and then go to training."
Long Shuhan picked up the storage backpack and placed it in front of Ye Lishang.
"Okay, Aunt Long."
After Ye Lishang agreed, he put the things into the storage backpack.
After putting the pistol, dagger, demon core, thermostatic suit and other items into the storage backpack, Ye Lishang discovered that this storage backpack was really extraordinary.
Putting so many things in it does not even take up one thousandth of the space of the backpack, and the weight of the backpack does not change at all, just like an empty bag.
Moreover, the small backpack is also very convenient to carry. When you go out, you can just carry it on your body. The style is also very good-looking.
After packing his small backpack, Ye Li Shang got up and went to cook.
Soon, the meal was ready. Ye Lishang and Long Shuhan finished their dinner and left the room and headed out of the city.
…
night.
In the quiet forest.
Long Shuhan's imperial beast, the Frozen Dragon Lord, was guiding the Yunrong Fox on the use of ice attributes.
Ye Lishang took a pistol and aimed at an ancient tree twenty meters ahead under the guidance of Long Shuhan.
Bang bang bang~
Ye Lishang fired more than a dozen shots in a row, and then the surrounding gradually fell into silence.
Long Shuhan looked at the ancient tree in front of him, his eyes blank and confused.
Ye Lishang's cheeks turned slightly red.
"Li Shang, you fired thirteen shots in a row. How did you do it without hitting a single shot?"
Long Shuhan asked with some confusion.
The ancient tree in front was about half a meter in diameter. For such a big target, she was really curious as to how Ye Lishang managed to do it without hitting even a single shot.
"Ahem~"
"Auntie, this is my first time touching a pistol, so my accuracy may be a little off."
Ye Li Shang lowered his head slightly, his face so red that it seemed like he could bleed.
Hmm~
